name: Xiaodeng Liuye
source:
An Illuminator of few words but sharp remarks. She is independent, frequently appears, and soon vanishes unexpectedly. Despite her small stature, she possesses exceptional power. It seems that she has a long history with Mildia Dream and was entrusted by her to train Fancia and Alina.

[spoiler]Tinia Lori is the "imaginary friend" that everyone had in their childhood. For Fancia, she needs a senior who can appear at any time and accompany her, and a teacher who can guide her to catch up with her friends.[/spoiler]
